Expected Result: The same broadcast is not re-shown/re-alerted as if it were new on every poll

Test Case Description: View current weather advisory for a terminal
Test Steps:
1. Open the passenger dashboard
2. View the Weather card
Expected Result: Correct weather condition (sunny/rain/storm) and label are displayed

Test Case Description: View advisory during rain/storm conditions
Test Steps: 1. View the Weather card when a monitored hub is experiencing rain
Expected Result: A passenger-facing rain/storm advisory (e.g., "Rain showers") is shown

Test Case Description: View fog/reduced-visibility advisory
Test Steps: 1. View the Weather card when a monitored hub reports fog
Expected Result: A "Fog / reduced visibility" advisory is shown

Test Case Description: View clear weather state (boundary)
Test Steps: 1. View the Weather card when conditions are clear
Expected Result: No advisory banner is shown, or a neutral "clear" state is shown

Test Case Description: View weather for multiple monitored hubs simultaneously
Test Steps: 1. View weather across more than one monitored terminal/hub
Expected Result: Each hub shows its own correct, independent condition

Test Case Description: View ""last refreshed"" badge accuracy
Test Steps:
1. Note the "last refreshed" timestamp on the Weather card
2. Compare against the actual last poll time
Expected Result: The displayed timestamp matches the real last successful poll

Test Case Description: [FAILURE] Weather provider (Open-Meteo) is unreachable
Test Steps:
1. Simulate the weather provider being unreachable
2. Open the dashboard
Expected Result: A graceful fallback is shown (cached/last-known or empty state); no crash; no fabricated condition is invented

Test Case Description: [RECOVERY] Weather resumes after the provider is reachable again
Test Steps:
1. Restore the weather provider after TC-WD-07
2. Wait for the next poll cycle
Expected Result: Current real conditions are retrieved and displayed again

Test Case Description: Weather-adjusted ETA reflects the active advisory
Test Steps: 1. With an active rain/storm advisory, compare a bus's displayed ETA against its ETA under clear conditions
Expected Result: The ETA under the active advisory is adjusted upward (longer), consistent with the weather delay multiplier

Test Case Description: View weather card before the first poll completes (boundary)
Test Steps: 1. Load the app and immediately view the Weather card, before the first poll cycle finishes
Expected Result: A loading/pending state is shown rather than a blank card or an incorrect default condition

Test Case Description: Valid attendant login
Test Steps:
1. Open the Bus Attendant app
2. Enter a valid operator email and password
3. Tap Log In
Expected Result: Login succeeds; app navigates to the Home dashboard

Test Case Description: Invalid attendant credentials
Test Steps:
1. Enter a valid operator email with the wrong password
2. Tap Log In
Expected Result: Error "Invalid credentials"; login blocked

Test Case Description: Login without an assigned bus
Test Steps: 1. Log in with an operator account that has no bus assigned
Expected Result: Login blocked with the bus-assignment-required error message

Test Case Description: Login with an inactive assigned bus
Test Steps: 1. Log in with an operator whose assigned bus status is Inactive
Expected Result: Error "Your assigned bus has been deactivated. You cannot sign in until an administrator reactivates the unit in Fleet management."

Test Case Description: Account lockout after repeated failed attempts
Test Steps: 1. Enter a valid email with an incorrect password repeatedly until the lockout threshold is reached
Expected Result: Error "Account temporarily locked after failed sign-in attempts. Try again later."

Test Case Description: Forgot-password / OTP reset flow
Test Steps:
1. Tap "Forgot Password"
2. Complete the OTP verification and reset steps
Expected Result: Password is reset successfully and the attendant can log in with the new password

Test Case Description: Session persists after app restart
Test Steps:
1. Log in successfully
2. Close and reopen the app
Expected Result: The attendant remains logged in; no re-login is required (stored token still valid)

Test Case Description: Expired/invalid stored token forces re-login
Test Steps: 1. With an expired or tampered stored token, open the app
Expected Result: The app detects the invalid session and returns the attendant to the login screen rather than silently failing subsequent requests

Test Case Description: [FAILURE] Fresh login attempt with no connectivity
Test Steps:
1. Disable all network connectivity on the device
2. Attempt to log in with valid credentials
Expected Result: The app clearly reports it cannot reach the server; no offline/cached login is granted, since no offline authentication mechanism is implemented
Remarks: No offline login capability exists for the attendant app; this is expected and by design.

Test Case Description: [RECOVERY] Login succeeds once connectivity is restored
Test Steps:
1. Restore connectivity after TC-AA-09
2. Retry login with the same valid credentials
Expected Result: Login succeeds normally

Test Case Description: View assigned bus/route/trip on Home

2. View the Home tab

Expected Result: Correct bus number, route, and current trip schedule are displayed

Test Case Description: View Home with no bus assigned (boundary)

Test Case Description: Dashboard reflects a new assignment after reassignment

Test Case Description: View current trip schedule/departure time

Test Case Description: Dashboard updates after an automatic route flip

Test Case Description: View driver information on the dashboard

Test Case Description: [FAILURE] Open Home tab while the assignment endpoint is unreachable

Test Case Description: [RECOVERY] Home tab loads correctly after backend is restored

Test Case Description: Pull-to-refresh updates dashboard data

Test Case Description: Reopen app mid-trip (data persistence)

3. Confirm issue

Test Case Description: Issue a ticket with missing required fields

Test Case Description: Issue a ticket with a student/PWD/senior discount

Test Case Description: [FAILURE/OFFLINE] Issue a ticket while the device has no connectivity

1. Disable network connectivity
2. Issue a ticket
Expected Result: The ticket is queued in the local ticket outbox and shown to the attendant as pending — it is not silently lost

Test Case Description: [RECOVERY] Queued ticket syncs after connectivity is restored

Expected Result: The queued ticket is automatically submitted and created server-side exactly once

Test Case Description: Retry after an ambiguous sync failure (duplicate prevention)
Test Steps:
1. Issue a ticket
2. Let the app auto-retry with the same clientRequestId (simulating a response that was lost in transit)
Test Data: Same clientRequestId as a previously issued ticket
Expected Result: The original ticket is returned with alreadyIssued: true; no duplicate ticket or fare charge is created

Test Case Description: [UNAUTHORIZED] Edit a ticket with an incorrect edit PIN

1. Attempt to edit a previously issued ticket
2. Enter an incorrect edit PIN
Expected Result: Edit is rejected; the ticket remains unchanged

Test Case Description: Edit a ticket with the correct verified PIN
Test Steps:
1. Attempt to edit a previously issued ticket
2. Enter the correct edit PIN
Expected Result: The edit is applied and recorded in the driver ticket edit log

Test Case Description: [FAILURE] Ticket issuance when backend returns a server error (not connectivity loss)
Test Steps: 1. With the device online, cause the issue-ticket request to receive a 500 response (controlled test)
Expected Result: The app does not falsely confirm issuance; the ticket is not created; a clear error distinct from a connectivity-loss state is shown
Remarks: Confirm whether this is handled identically to the offline-queue path or as a distinct error before marking Pass.

Test Case Description: Issue several tickets in quick succession (data integrity)
Test Steps: 1. Issue 5 tickets in rapid succession while online
Expected Result: Each ticket receives a correct, unique ticket code; no collisions or dropped tickets occur

Test Case Description: [FAILURE] Backend returns an error for a GPS ping (not a connectivity loss)

Test Case Description: End-of-trip stops GPS transmission
